scientific_judgements: Risk factors expressed as tendencies, not individual predictions. Gender objective taught as a population sex-related risk distinction without diagnosis.
Quiet versus forced expiration is distinguished; internal intercostals are not asserted to drive every quiet expiration.
Milk antibodies protect particularly at mucosal surfaces; swallowed antibodies are not all asserted to enter infant blood.
Root transport distinguishes membrane osmosis, wall pathways and xylem bulk flow.
Pesticide entry mechanism remains unsupported; internal phloem distribution does not establish uptake mechanism.
Graph-related C-35 framework defect is not bypassed with fictitious business data.

Quiver tree is credited only with water storage in its stem and branches; the unsourced reflective-coating claim was removed in round 2. Sunken stomata and small surface area are taught as general xerophyte features, not asserted for the aloe or quiver tree.
